Launch driven

Script 1 · “Old identity”

“Here’s why the same situations keep showing up, no matter how clear the vision is.”

Script 2 · “Forcing vs receiving”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If manifesting feels like hard work, try this instead.”

Body

“Forcing sounds like checking, chasing and doubting. Receiving sounds like deciding, releasing and trusting. It’s a different energy, and it can be practised every single day.”

CTA

“In The Timeline Shift I’ll walk you through the practice live. 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to two columns on screen, “forcing” crossed out, “receiving” in gold.

Script 3 · “The daily ritual”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The people who hold a shift all have one daily habit.”

Body

“They don’t wait for a big moment. Every morning they choose who they’re being today, and every evening they notice where the old identity crept in. Small, consistent, and it changes how the whole day feels.”
